{
  "hazard_consequence_node": [
    {
      "label": "HazardConsequence",
      "name": "Confined explosion",
      "node_id": "H1",
      "node_type": "HazardConsequence",
      "evidence": "The report states that on January 7, 2010, the student was injured \"after the chemical he was working with detonated.\" In the incident description, \"he transferred about half of the synthesized NHP into a mortar, added hexane... [and] the compound detonated.\" The analysis repeatedly focuses on the explosive hazards of the energetic material, the scale-up to about 10 grams, and the lack of formal hazard evaluation for that explosive risk.",
      "explanation": "The central accident mechanism analyzed is the detonation/explosion of an energetic solid during handling in a mortar. Among the available labels, this is best represented as a confined explosion because the incident is fundamentally an explosive event localized in handling equipment, not a vapor cloud, BLEVE, dust cloud, fire, or toxic/asphyxiation event.",
      "source": "incident_description"
    }
  ],
  "entity_nodes": [
    {
      "label": "Material",
      "name": "nickel hydrazine perchlorate (NHP) derivative",
      "node_id": "En1",
      "node_type": "Entity",
      "evidence": "\"began synthesizing a nickel hydrazine perchlorate (NHP) derivative\"",
      "explanation": "This was the energetic compound being synthesized, scaled up, and handled when the detonation occurred.",
      "source": "incident_description"
    },
    {
      "label": "Location",
      "name": "mortar",
      "node_id": "En2",
      "node_type": "Entity",
      "evidence": "\"transferred about half of the synthesized NHP into a mortar\"",
      "explanation": "The material was being handled in a mortar immediately before the explosion.",
      "source": "incident_description"
    }
  ],
  "condition_nodes": [
    {
      "label": "Phase",
      "name": "Solid",
      "node_id": "C1",
      "node_type": "Condition",
      "evidence": "\"observed clumps in the product\"",
      "explanation": "The energetic material was present as a solid product, although it had been wetted with hexane.",
      "source": "incident_description"
    },
    {
      "label": "Pressure",
      "name": "Not specified",
      "node_id": "C2",
      "node_type": "Condition",
      "evidence": "N/A",
      "explanation": "The incident description does not specify a pressure condition or a pressurized system.",
      "source": "Not specified"
    },
    {
      "label": "Temperature",
      "name": "Not specified",
      "node_id": "C3",
      "node_type": "Condition",
      "evidence": "N/A",
      "explanation": "The incident description does not specify the temperature of the material or surroundings.",
      "source": "Not specified"
    },
    {
      "label": "Volatility",
      "name": "Not specified",
      "node_id": "C4",
      "node_type": "Condition",
      "evidence": "N/A",
      "explanation": "The incident description does not explicitly state the volatility of the hazardous material driving the explosion scenario.",
      "source": "Not specified"
    },
    {
      "label": "Combustibility",
      "name": "Combustible",
      "node_id": "C5",
      "node_type": "Condition",
      "evidence": "\"the potential explosive hazards associated with the quantity of NHP synthesized\"",
      "explanation": "The material exhibited energetic behavior and detonated, indicating combustible/explosive reactivity.",
      "source": "incident_description"
    },
    {
      "label": "ToxicSubstance",
      "name": "Not specified",
      "node_id": "C6",
      "node_type": "Condition",
      "evidence": "N/A",
      "explanation": "The incident description does not identify toxicity as the driving hazard in this scenario.",
      "source": "Not specified"
    },
    {
      "label": "Asphyxiant",
      "name": "Not specified",
      "node_id": "C7",
      "node_type": "Condition",
      "evidence": "N/A",
      "explanation": "The incident description does not indicate an asphyxiation hazard.",
      "source": "Not specified"
    },
    {
      "label": "Conductivity",
      "name": "Not specified",
      "node_id": "C8",
      "node_type": "Condition",
      "evidence": "N/A",
      "explanation": "The incident description does not provide information about the electrical conductivity of the material.",
      "source": "Not specified"
    },
    {
      "label": "ReleaseType",
      "name": "Instant release",
      "node_id": "C9",
      "node_type": "Condition",
      "evidence": "\"At this point, the compound detonated.\"",
      "explanation": "The hazardous event occurred suddenly rather than as a prolonged release.",
      "source": "incident_description"
    },
    {
      "label": "Confinement",
      "name": "Low confinement",
      "node_id": "C10",
      "node_type": "Condition",
      "evidence": "\"into a mortar\"",
      "explanation": "The material was in an open mortar rather than a closed vessel, indicating limited confinement.",
      "source": "incident_description"
    },
    {
      "label": "Dispersion",
      "name": "Not dispersed",
      "node_id": "C11",
      "node_type": "Condition",
      "evidence": "\"transferred about half of the synthesized NHP into a mortar, added hexane\"",
      "explanation": "The material remained as a localized wetted solid in the mortar; no vapor or dust cloud dispersion before detonation is described.",
      "source": "incident_description"
    }
  ],
  "event_nodes": [
    {
      "label": "InitiatingEvent",
      "name": "Scale-up of NHP synthesis to approximately 10 grams",
      "node_id": "Ev1",
      "node_type": "Event",
      "evidence": "\"they decided to scale-up the synthesis of NHP to make approximately 10 grams\"",
      "explanation": "The accident sequence began when the energetic material was intentionally scaled up from small laboratory quantities to a much larger batch.",
      "source": "incident_description"
    },
    {
      "label": "IgnitionSource",
      "name": "Unknown ignition source",
      "node_id": "Ev2",
      "node_type": "Event",
      "evidence": "\"did not replace his goggles while he stirred the NHP “one more time.” At this point, the compound detonated.\"",
      "explanation": "A detonation occurred during manual stirring, but the incident description does not identify the exact ignition or initiation source.",
      "source": "incident_description"
    }
  ]
}
